name: Roth.wronskian_ne_zero_of_natDegree_injective
source:
theorem wronskian_ne_zero_of_natDegree_injective [CharZero K] {φ : Fin l → K[X]} (hφ : ∀ ν, φ ν ≠ 0)
    (hd : Function.Injective fun ν ↦ (φ ν).natDegree) : wronskian φ ≠ 0 := by
  intro h0
  simpa [h0, det_choose_eq, eq_comm (a := 0), Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero, hφ,
    Nat.factorial_ne_zero, hd.eq_iff] using coeff_wronskian_of_natDegree_injective (φ := φ)

what: A nonzero polynomial family of pairwise-distinct degrees has nonzero Wronskian in characteristic zero.
how: Combines coeff_wronskian_of_natDegree_injective with det_choose_eq; leading coefficients, factorials, and Vandermonde differences are all nonzero, contradicting a zero Wronskian.
hypotheses: A characteristic-zero field, all family members nonzero, and injective natural degree function.
